title: CPG Node Event
description: Mot node trong Code Property Graph (chu yeu la AST node). Publish len topic 'code.events.nodes'. Message KEY = file_path (gom moi event cua cung 1 file vao cung partition, giu dung thu tu). Chong trung KHONG dua vao Kafka key ma dua vao Cypher MERGE theo node_id trong payload.

schema_version.description: Phien ban schema. Giup consumer doc dung message cu khi schema doi trong tuong lai (forward compatibility).

event_timestamp.description: Event-time: thoi diem parser sinh ra node nay (ISO 8601 UTC). KHONG phai thoi diem Kafka nhan message.

node_id.description: Stable ID = sha256(file_path | qualified_scope | node_type | sibling_index)[:24]. KHONG chua so dong (line_start/line_end) de khi sua file, node khong bi doi id -> giu idempotent cho Task 6. On dinh qua cac lan parse lai -> nen tang cua idempotency.

node_type.description: Loai node AST, vi du: Module, FunctionDef, ClassDef, If, For, While, Try, Call, Assign, Name, Return...

name.description: Ten bieu tuong neu co (ten ham/lop/bien). null neu node khong co ten (vi du: node If).

file_path.description: Duong dan tuong doi cua file trong repo, vi du 'src/models/bert.py'.

line_start.description: Dong bat dau cua node trong file (1-based theo ast). Chi la thuoc tinh MO TA, KHONG nam trong hash node_id; duoc cap nhat qua MERGE...SET moi lan parse lai.

line_end.description: Dong ket thuc cua node. Chi la thuoc tinh MO TA, KHONG nam trong hash node_id.

code_snippet.description: Doan code ngan (tuy chon) de doi chieu. NEN cat ngan (vi du <= 200 ky tu) tranh message qua lon.

repo.description: Ten repo dang phan tich, vi du 'huggingface/transformers-pr-agent'.

repo_commit.description: Commit hash cua repo luc parse. Giup truy vet node thuoc phien ban code nao.
